title: Laser pointer for mouse and pen

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The saved timestamp candidate remains unbuilt and untested. Source tracing identifies LaserPointer.UnitTests, not ZoomIt, as the relevant native unit-test target. The proposed deterministic case adds the same point twice at different times and checks both continued presence and eventual expiry; the existing stationary-pointer test checks only point count. Target imports, required native test framework, dependency baseline and direct build/test commands are recorded. No regression test was added or run in this step. A unit result would not establish visible overlay behavior, which additionally requires an interactive check.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
